dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical narrowing from the mid-body toward the posterior peduncle ending in a pointed terminus.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins are smooth and symmetrical with no visible localized bulges or indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey median intensity across the visible dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse darker grey patches are visible along the lateral margins and posterior third of the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Gradient boundaries between pigmented grey regions and the lighter baseline are diffuse.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A distinct, light-colored linear mark is visible on the upper mid-dorsal plane, slightly offset from the central axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A visible linear light-pigmented scar is present on the upper mid-dorsal region.
